consumer_contract: Match the failing job's step log against markers (first match by precedence order); apply prescription; respect auto_repairable and escalation; record outcome (repaired/escalated/watch-only-guard-correct) in the repair ledger.

classes.title: recursive-artifact drift (lane registered, artifact absent)
classes.prescription: Drop the lane registration from the roster (commit 2748b52 precedent); keep the file lane pending; re-register with an rc=111 skip protocol when the file lands.
classes.guard: Roster derivation asserts file existence per lane at roster-build time.
classes.escalation: If the missing file belongs to another pending lane, notify that lane's owner in the repair ledger.

classes.title: mechanical-wash overreach (frozen/self-referential faces)
classes.prescription: Surgical revert of touched frozen faces to pre-round content (checkout HEAD^ -- <faces>); keep clean improvements; three-station re-pin; record class in round ledger.
classes.guard: Exclusion table as single source (tools/repair_scope.py); self-reference guard (--a2-table precedent); certification faces never in wash scope.
classes.escalation: Re-landing the intended improvement on non-frozen faces requires a seat.

classes.title: stale repair target (superseded head)
classes.prescription: Compare-API discrimination (ahead/identical = covered, skip; behind/diverged/error = proceed); re-apply the prepared fix onto the current head with git apply --3way; conflicts escalate to the desk.
classes.guard: Freshness check immediately before any repair push (223b618 precedent).
classes.escalation: 3-way conflicts are adjudicated by a session, not retried.

classes.title: intent & queue (cancelled resurrected / queue fission)
markers: cancelled by queued run entry (cancel-in-progress churn)
classes.prescription: None - the guard is the repair. Manual rerun remains available to the desk. Churn variant: cancel-in-progress OFF + ci_queue_governor trims stale QUEUED runs per branch (in_progress never touched).
classes.guard: cancelled = intent, never auto-revived; queue governor MAX_QUEUED_RUNS=3, oldest trimmed, in-progress untouched.

classes.title: fitness absence (verify gate validates the validator)
classes.prescription: Rewire autonomy.json verify_cmd to the axiom_guard compile leg (see techdocs contract); repairs and rounds share the gate; ledger verify_kind=axiom_guard.
classes.guard: Round and repair commits share the same fitness gate.
classes.escalation: Gate cost measurement feeds the round cadence (desk sets parameters).

classes.title: watchdog reflexivity (skip≠red, runner self-death, dependency-tree currency)
classes.prescription: Three-way conclusion reading (success/failed/skipped - skipped = guard-correct); sync the out-of-repo dependency tree before landing; escalate watch-death with heartbeat evidence to the desk.
classes.guard: Watch-the-watch heartbeat; dependency documented in the service map (techdocs/本机服务面与勿扰清单).
classes.escalation: Runner lifecycle and watch death are desk-gated.

classes.title: environment-branch fix with an unexercised branch
classes.prescription: Add the missing import/requirement on the fallback branch; land; add the face to the platform-sensitive watch until three consecutive greens.
classes.guard: Every new host-branch in a fix must be executed at least once before landing (unset the env vars locally and run).
classes.escalation: If the branch cannot be exercised locally, gate the fix behind an rc=111 skip protocol.

classes.title: service-face coupling (repo updates break local services)
classes.prescription: Follow the service map recovery pointers (techdocs/本机服务面与勿扰清单); tool signatures additive-only; matrix labels checked against runner labels; stop-the-line on any service anomaly.
classes.guard: Service map read is mandatory before touching mcp_server.py / ci.yml matrix / sentinel CLI.

classes.title: platform evolution (runtime deprecations)
classes.prescription: Bump the action to the latest release (fetch-before-use: check the action repo's latest tag); keep the flag face; watch one run.
classes.guard: Quarterly uses: audit against each action's latest release (e213276 precedent: upload-artifact v4 to v7.0.2).
classes.escalation: If the latest release changes the input schema, escalate before bumping.

classes.title: multi-session collision (same tree, same machine)
classes.prescription: Union merges via git merge-file / apply --3way onto the current head; stash-rebase(resign)-push-pop dance for pending-lane overlaps; record both sides in the ledger.
classes.guard: Face/meal selection reads git status --porcelain first and excludes dirty faces (collision-free matrix before concurrency).
classes.escalation: Conflicting intents between lanes are adjudicated by the desk.

classes.title: shallow runner checkout x frozen git-anchor (DRIFT false-flag)
classes.prescription: The runner workspace .git is shallow (.git/shallow present): merge-base cannot see the freeze-commit ancestry and false-flags DRIFT. Desk one-time fix: git fetch --unshallow from the local dev tree (file:// transport, zero-network) in the runner workspace. Durable fix: frozen8 check detects the shallow state first and downgrades the git-anchor ring (desk-gated, frozen face).
classes.guard: ci.yml self-hosted checkout carries fetch-depth: 0; the runner workspace keeps full history after one unshallow.

classes.title: environment-conditional contract branch x runner PATH drift
classes.prescription: A report/refuse branch keyed on environment presence flipped when the runner PATH gained a dependency: move the clean-mode check ABOVE the presence gate (report always, exit 1, never execute), make the rc-asserting test vectors environment-aware, verify the fix on BOTH faces (PATH stub simulates presence), then rerun the failed jobs. Diagnosis: _runner_loop.log timeline + PATH-stub reproduction on the old blob. Desk-gated: the repair touches tool + test contract.
classes.guard: Every report/refuse branch keyed on environment presence must be executed on BOTH faces before landing (PATH stub simulates presence); report-not-execute contracts live ABOVE the presence gate; rc-asserting test vectors are environment-aware (assert the invariant, not one environment rc).

classes.title: silent gate stall (a gate reads a signal no trigger produces)
classes.guard: Every gate requires its signal wired end to end (trigger -> run -> verdict); a gate with no producer is a stall, not a hold; a reconcile line repeating identically for hours is the stall fingerprint.
classes.prescription: Extend the trigger (pull_request opened/synchronize/reopened), broaden the match (push/workflow_dispatch/pull_request runs - PR-event head_sha is the merge-ref commit, match the pull_requests link too), self-start the missing signal (dispatch ci.yml at the PR head branch), and gate on the hosted faces via the jobs API (the local self-hosted face is main-only evidence). Parse-death blindness: a validation-failed file emits no workflow_run event, so the scheduled reconcile carries the read-only parse-death probe (newest main run jobs=0); the blocking-file fix is desk-gated.

classes.title: data-shape change -> consumer breakage (seed form migration)
markers: source drifted from the pinned snapshot
classes.guard: A shape migration must land with every consumer of the old shape patched in the same commit; the sync tool runs a post-sync consumer smoke as its exit gate; hosted-green + canonical-red means the red is real.
classes.prescription: Reproduce on the canonical machine by calling the check functions directly; patch each consumer to accept BOTH shapes during the transition; re-sign drifted provenance md5 per the sync discipline; move time-dependent assertions when the shape becomes legal. Push only after the canonical three-gate run is green.

classes.title: provenance pin drift on a canonical-only verification layer (snapshot md5)
markers: source drifted from the pinned snapshot
re-transcribe the seed per the sync discipline
classes.prescription: On the canonical machine run the sync tool zero-write plan (python -I tools/jargon_map_sync.py) and require VERDICT IN-SYNC; if IN-SYNC, re-sign the drifted md5 in seeds/jargon/jargon-map.json provenance.sources (wave59 precedent 6d79e29, live precedent b3cbcf0) and land it the same commit as any source edit; if the plan is NOT in sync, escalate (content retag needed, machine-apply is alternation-guarded). Verify with python -I tests/t_engines_seeds.py (jargon segment 9/0) before pushing. A hosted-verifiable pin form (repo-relative in-repo sources) is a desk-gated design change. DISCRIMINATOR (run 44506833563): if the zero-write plan verdicts IN-SYNC while snapshot-md5 still drifts, this is the cross-tree race R17, NOT drift - do NOT re-sign; tree-sync + rerun instead. DESIGN LANDED (provenance v2, November 19, 2026, schema face docs/pin-provenance-v2.md): repo sources pin the committed blob sha (git rev-parse HEAD:<path>) and external sources pin the md5 of in-repo byte snapshots under seeds/jargon/_snapshots/, so the consistency layer verifies on every face; the freshness layer stays canonical-only and reports a declared SKIP (never a silent one) off the canonical machine; this row's hosted-blindness wording describes the v1 pin form.
classes.guard: Re-sign only behind the sync tool's zero-write plan verdict IN-SYNC (content healthy, pin alone stale); a pinned-source edit and its md5 re-sign are same-commit (R14 cousin); hosted-green + canonical-red here is structural - the pinned sources sit at absolute paths hosted runners cannot open (OSError -> SKIP), so the canonical face is the only layer that verifies. DESIGN LANDED: under the v2 pin form the consistency layer runs on hosted faces too (blob-sha and snapshot-md5 pins, no absolute-path OSError); the structural-canonical-only statement above is the v1 form's record (schema face docs/pin-provenance-v2.md).

classes.title: fingerprint-gate exemption dead (hashFiles negation) / FP machinery red
classes.prescription: Fingerprint the committed tree directly: git ls-tree -r HEAD minus the pure-prose allowlist (grep -v filter + git hash-object --stdin; standing form landed in 74cc082) - restore that form if a regression reintroduces hashFiles negation patterns; verify locally against real commit pairs (prose-only diff leaves FP unchanged, code/data diffs change it); the next prose-only push must take the ANCHORS branch - judge the mode by the job-step conclusions (anchor-tier step success = ANCHORS), never the run-level conclusion (the local face has no gate; other faces may red for unrelated roots).
classes.guard: An FP exemption is only real if two runs' verdict-cache keys prove it: push a diff confined to the allowlist faces and compare keys - equality exempts, difference indicts the construction. The canonical local face carries no gate (R12) and never skips.

classes.title: cross-tree pin race (checkout seed vs absolute-path source desync)
markers: source drifted from the pinned snapshot
canonical reproduces green on the red commit
classes.prescription: Never re-sign in this shape - the current bytes are the STALER side and a re-sign would regress the pin and mask newer content. Signature check: the sync tool zero-write plan verdicts IN-SYNC while snapshot-md5 drifts (seed entries match the table, so only the pin-vs-file pair is stale) - that is the race, not R15 drift. Repair: bring the dev tree to the run head (desk; the runner checkout is already there), verify the seed suite green locally on the exact red commit, then rerun-failed-jobs (precedent run 44506833563 attempt 2 all-green, repair ledger EXP-20261119-0002). Durable cure candidate (third live evidence): repo-relative in-repo pin sources would collapse the two-tree window and the hosted structural blindness in one desk-gated design change. DESIGN LANDED (provenance v2, November 19, 2026, schema face docs/pin-provenance-v2.md): the race's repo-source form is structurally dead - a repo source is judged against the blob sha recorded in its own commit, so no second tree's working bytes can enter the judgment; the external freshness layer remains canonical-only with a declared SKIP.
classes.guard: The pinned absolute path crosses two trees (the runner checkout vs the dev tree working file); between the JOB_STARTED ref-sync and working-file catch-up the two disagree. Same words as R15, opposite disease - the discriminator is the sync plan verdict. Re-signing is R15-only, behind a non-race diagnosis. DESIGN LANDED: the v2 pin form removes the two-tree window for repo sources (the pin travels inside the commit); the two-tree wording above is the v1 form's record and still applies to the external freshness layer on the canonical face.

classes.title: evidence snapshot re-laid by a doc-face wave (i18n x evidence-layer conflict)
classes.prescription: Restore evidence semantics: the true bytes (desktop-authority md5, preserved by the wave in the .zh.md sibling) return to the primary snapshot slot; the re-laid face moves to a clearly-labeled non-evidence name (.docface-re-laid); pins re-sign to the normalized snapshot md5 (annotation 8876e13f..., terminology 0eb8bf56... - v2 standing values). The foreign pin registers as a reconciliation finding for the seat (annotation-copy divergence desktop vs Mac, live case f390121c). Verify with python -I tests/t_engines_seeds.py (jargon segment 9/0, all five layers green).
classes.guard: _snapshots/ files are corpus, not prose: the five-gate sweep exempts them by registration (basis: byte-exact external evidence), and doc-face re-lays never touch them; upstream changes re-sign only from the DESKTOP authority through the sync tool (normalized md5), never from a foreign copy. The suite's snapshot-md5 check is the tripwire - it caught R15, R17 and R18 within one face run each.
